title: fix: restore Polli GitHub Astra and migrate remaining Luna jobs
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Restores `openai/gpt-6-astra` for Polli's GitHub coding requests, correcting the tier change in #15505. Background tasks remain on GPT-6 Luna; read-only `askpolli` remains on GPT-6 Sol.
- Fixes organizer 403s by migrating its missed GPT-5.6 Luna selection to GPT-6 Luna. Also updates app-submission review and the standalone review helper.
- Validation: 20 existing workflow/review tests, Python syntax, Biome and `git diff --check` pass. Bot keys already permit GPT-6 Luna and Astra. The original organizer rerun and a GPT-6 organizer dry run both passed.
- Rollout: temporarily restored GPT-5.6 Luna on the shared GitHub bot key so existing `main` consumers and old workflow reruns work. Remove that permission after these consumers are merged and verified on `main`; credential material is unchanged.

gist.headline: Polli gets her tools back
gist.blurb: Polli’s GitHub coding requests are back on Astra, and the organizer can get through its work again. The review helpers have made the move to Luna too.
gist.summary: Restored openai/gpt-6-astra for Polli’s GitHub coding requests and migrated the organizer, app-submission review, and standalone review helper to GPT-6 Luna, while read-only askpolli stays on GPT-6 Sol.
gist.impact: Contributors get Astra-backed coding responses again, and organizer jobs can run on GPT-6 Luna without the model-selection 403s.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli at a cozy GitHub-workflow desk, placing an Astra-labeled coding tool beside a working organizer terminal; small Luna-labeled review folders and a Sol-labeled reading nook distinguish the three jobs. A code-plant and lime-green monitor glow keep the internal workflow scene warm and legible.
